faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers on news, Exur chat, and what the app will not do.

items.whatA: Exur is a focused market-intelligence app. Scored news bullets for the market you select, plus an Exur co-pilot when you connect an account. Browse headlines without signing in.
items.newsA: Curated headlines ranked for relevance to your selected market, so you can scan what matters instead of scrolling feeds.
items.chatbotA: No. Exur is built for market context. It reads the headlines and market you have open, then returns focused answers, not open-ended chat.
items.askA: Anything about the active market or a headline you are reading: why it matters, what to watch next, or how it fits the wider tape.
items.accountA: Not to browse news. Open the app and read headlines without signing in. Connect an account for co-pilot chat, history, and plan limits on Free or Plus.
items.freeQ: How do Free and Plus differ?
items.freeA: Free includes the full news feed with a daily co-pilot send cap and a weekly usage limit. Plus raises both for people who use Exur every session.
items.profitsA: No. News scores and co-pilot replies support your process. They are not promises of return, win rate, or accuracy. Exur is analysis, not financial advice.
